Egil wasn't known as a gentle soul, he was a product of his time, a pragmatic realist. He was a warrior when needed, a poet, and a magician.... he encompassed all of the aspects of his patron God, Odin. At the end of it all though he cared deeply about his family. Be the warrior as needed, but in all instances remember your family, your ancestral line that brought you to where you are today and those future descendants who will reflect back on your name and memory........let them reflect back on someone and something truly noble and worthy of a saga in their own right.
